turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Banerjee from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Arjun from the fraud monitoring team at your bank. We have noticed a suspicious transaction of twenty five thousand rupees on your card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Twenty five thousand? Oh my god, I did not do any such shopping today!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I suspected as much. Did you authorize any payments to an online electronics store in the last hour?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, no, I have been at home all day. Is my money gone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry, we have already placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further loss. Is that alright with you?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, yes, please block it immediately. What do I need to do now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You do not need to do anything. Just be aware that our bank will never ask you for an OTP, your PIN, or the CVV number over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. Will you be sending me a new card?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, we will mail a replacement to your registered address. Please just wait for the official confirmation SMS.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you so much, Arjun. You have been very helpful.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, Mrs. Banerjee. Have a safe day ahead.
